Week 16, August 19, 2026 in St. Petersburg

Week 16-- Sous Chefs C and R take on St. Pete!

Transfer news!!! (I know, finally!) The correct answer from my last email is that on Thursday I went down to Tampa...

...to meet my new companion, Sister Robison! We're whitewashing our new area, St. Pete, and Elders replaced my old area.

So if you guessed answer b, you were correct! As promised, here are your brownie points:

(🧈 🥚🍦🍬 (🔨 🍫) 🌼🧂 🍫) x 1000

They're homemade because there's no brownie emoji. Enjoy!

I'm going to miss Ocala so much (the Elders replacing me and Sister Crowther don't know how good they have it), but St. Pete is so much fun! We're replacing Elders here, so the whole ward is so excited to have Sisters for the first time in years!! On our first day here we got sooo many texts from people in the ward welcoming us :) And Bishop is the best (tied up there with my last bishop)! He told the whole ward we were coming and started building member trust for us before we even met anyone!

Thursday, 08/13 Last morning in Ocala! 😭 I truly love it there and I'm really going to miss all of my friends and the members up there! That morning we woke up, packed Sister Frey's bags in their car, drove over to my apartment and commandeered two sets of Elders to help bring my stuff down to Tampa.

Then Sister George, Sister Frey and I drove down to Tampa for transfers. Sister George is training a brand new missionary up in Ocala and Sister Frey went down to Ft. Myers (she went from the top of our mission to the bottom).

Bishop called us Thursday evening to ask if we could stop by his house. All we had that night was referral and member stop-bys, so we of course said yes! Their oldest daughter was so happy to have Sisters-- she wrote a cute note on their door for us ❤️ ❤️ 🥰 Bishop told us about the members and his plan for how we can help the ward, and his daughter made us her sous chefs in her endeavor to make pumpkin soup (it unfortunately burned while we were going over the member list with Bishop).

Friday, 08/14 The Elders cleaned the apartment before we came, which was pretty awesome of them! The two weirdest parts of the apartment are the box of 60 eggs in the fridge and the giant giraffe on the kitchen light.

Saturday, 08/15 Guess who just got transferred to a coastal area and goes to the gulf for contacting! (This one should be easy)

I do!! We need to make phone work fun somehow because it takes so long.

Sunday, 08/16 Both Sister Robison and I gave talks this Sunday. We also had two friends come to church!!

Monday, 08/17 Weekly planning only took a million years.

We stopped by a returning member and she was literally so awesome!! Her name's April and she's going through a lot but she sees Christ's hand in her life making it easier. Keep her in your prayers!

Tuesday, 08/18 We get a lot of referrals in this area. Some of them are from people that we already have records for (they sent in a referral in the past or had contact with the missionaries at some point). There's this lovely feature in our area book that allows us to merge these records so every interaction with the same person is in one place. The Elders did not take advantage of this feature. Not just the Elders we replaced-- I don't think any Elder ever in St. Pete merged any records. There's a bunch of duplicate records-- almost all of our friends and referrals have 1-2 past records. I merged our referral Kimberly seven times!! To my missionaries reading this email: merge your dots!!

Wednesday, 08/19 I saw Sister Nelson today!! She's outside of my district, but she's inside my zone. Both of our districts separately decided to go to Top Golf at the same time. It was so fun to see her and her companion, who came to Florida in the same group as us!

There is a Come, Follow Me scripture study later tonight, which we knew about when we got here. We just figured out that we are the ones teaching it. Wish us luck!

Spiritual thought Mosiah 24:14 And I will also ease the burdens which are put upon your shoulders, that even you cannot feel them upon your backs, even while you are in bondage; and this will I do that ye may stand as witnesses for me hereafter, and that ye may know of a surety that I, the Lord God, do visit my people in their afflictions.

I know that Christ is there to lift your burdens when you pray for help. He won't always take away your trials, but He is there to help you carry them.

If you made it this far, you've probably realized that I spent way too much time writing this email and not enough time responding to you-- I did not get to respond to anyone's emails today. Thank you so much for reaching out, I really appreciate it! I'll try to respond next week, but no promises 😬

Such is what befell me, most noteworthy, Sister Christison
